name: Windey Energy Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Windey Energy Technology Group Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells wind turbines in China. It also invests in and operates new energy power station projects, as well as provides smart services. In addition, the company offers new energy EPC general contracting services, grid-connected products and services, and new energy digital products. Windey Energy Technology Group Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
